subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Is the current contributor proof sufficient for the legacy no-code SQLite upgrade path, or should merge wait for visible latest-head terminal/log/artifact proof?
rationale: The code path is plausible and tested, but the remaining changed behavior affects upgraded persisted state and the latest proof does not visibly show the legacy SQLite row and startup/rederive outcome.

options.title: Require legacy upgrade proof
options.body: Ask for redacted latest-head terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code `diagnostics_json` row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds.

options.title: Accept source and CI proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the tests and source inspection as sufficient, but that waives external real-behavior proof for upgraded persisted state.

options.title: Move legacy cleanup out of runtime
options.body: Pause this PR direction and require the no-code cleanup to live in doctor or migration-owned code instead of runtime stale detection.

recommendation.title: Require legacy upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted latest-head terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code `diagnostics_json` row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the explicit-marker direction on the predecessor and are the most recent current-main owner for the touched plugin registry paths.
